response.sql: WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM groups) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share_of_total, share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10;
